The '''Minder of Weak Wills''' was a [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] [[The Force/Legends|Force]] user who was an unwilling follower of [[Exar Kun/Legends|Exar Kun]].

==Biography==
The Minder of Weak Wills was a former student at [[Corellia University/Legends|Corellia University]]. The Minder was enslaved after a archaeological dig on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]] she was involved in had unknowingly tunneled into the burial chamber of the [[Temple of Exar Kun]] and released the ancient Sith Lord's spirit. The entire team was subsequently enslaved by the malevolent spirit and were ordered into the [[Cult of Exar Kun]]. Later, a [[Corellia University research outpost]] on [[Talus/Legends|Talus]] was invaded by the Cult and all its students and researchers were enslaved as well, afterward most were brought back to Yavin 4. Fearing why he had lost contact with the outpost, [[Cornelius Wagglehorn|Professor Cornelius Wagglehorn]] hired a group of spacers to travel to Talus and investigate. The spacers learned what had transpired and informed the professor.

He provided them with the coordinates to the tomb and implored them to destroy the evil [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord's]] spirit within. The Minder was the second major obstacle the spacers encountered within the tomb, having just triumphed over [[Open Hand of Hate]]. The Minder had been empowered with [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] by Kun's spirit, and she used it to bend various creatures to her will. Commanding an army of tomb flier bats and skreegs, she ordered them to attack the spacers. The spacers eventually killed her pets and she was forced to take matters into her own hands. After a relatively short fight, she was killed by the combined might of the group, her spirit freed from the grasp of the evil [[Exar Kun/Legends|Exar Kun]]. Afterward, the spacers continued deeper into the tomb, eventually coming upon the [[Caretaker of the Lost Souls]].

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Minder_of_Weak_Wills_SWG.png|thumb|right|200px|The Minder of Weak Wills in ''Star Wars Galaxies'']]
The Minder of Weak Wills was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:EK" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Minder of Weak Wills was added to the game as part of the [[W:c:swg:Exar Kun|"Exar Kun" Heroic Encounter]],<ref name="SWG:EK" /> introduced with the release of the [[W:c:swg:Chapter 9 Notes for April 3 2008|"Chapter 9" update]], on [[April 3]], [[2008]].<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter 9: The Fury of Exar Kun">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67688&month=042008|text=Chapter 9: The Fury of Exar Kun}}</ref>

The Minder of Weak Wills was a "boss" enemy NPC in the Temple of Exar Kun Heroic Encounter. She was the second encounter in the instance, coming after the Open Hand of Hate and before the Caretaker of Lost Souls.
